title: Flow Mesh: A Velocity-Regularized Flow Matching Framework for Stable Distributional Modeling of Physical Fields on Unstructured Meshes
abstract: arXiv:2610.33204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Thermal-fluid field distributions underpin the analysis and operation of energy infrastructure, from nuclear-reactor cooling channels to industrial heat exchangers, but resolving these distributions through computational fluid dynamics requires prohibitively large simulation ensembles. Their complex geometries also demand unstructured meshes that are poorly accommodated by generative models developed for regular grids. Here we introduce FlowMesh, a generative framework that combines permutation-invariant mesh encoding with deterministic latent flow matching and an l1 penalty on the learned transport velocity. FlowMesh generates full-field realizations directly on fixed unstructured meshes without auxiliary grid interpolation or a stochastic denoising chain. Across lid-driven-cavity, pressurized-water-reactor subchannel and heat-exchanger datasets, evaluated over six matched training seeds, FlowMesh achieves macro-averaged probability-d

translated_title: FlowMesh：一种速度正则化的流匹配框架，用于非结构化网格上物理场的稳定分布建模
translated_abstract: 热流体场分布是能源基础设施分析与运行的基础，应用范围涵盖从核反应堆冷却通道到工业换热器等领域，但通过计算流体力学求解这些分布需要规模庞大到难以承受的模拟集合。此外，这些系统复杂的几何结构要求使用非结构化网格，而为规则网格开发的生成模型难以很好地适应这类网格。本文提出了FlowMesh，这是一个生成框架，它将置换不变的网格编码与确定性潜空间流匹配以及对学习到的输运速度施加L1范数惩罚相结合。FlowMesh能够直接在固定的非结构化网格上生成全场实现，无需辅助网格插值或随机去噪链。在顶盖驱动方腔流、压水堆子通道和换热器数据集上，通过对六个匹配的训练随机种子进行评估，FlowMesh在宏观平均的概率……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: FlowMesh是一个将置换不变网格编码、确定性潜空间流匹配与输运速度L1正则化相结合的生成框架，能够直接在非结构化网格上稳定生成热流体物理场分布，无需网格插值或随机去噪过程。
en_tdlr: FlowMesh is a generative framework that combines permutation-invariant mesh encoding, deterministic latent flow matching, and an L1 penalty on transport velocity to stably generate thermal-fluid field distributions directly on unstructured meshes without grid interpolation or stochastic denoising.
